findings.claim: The core acceptance criterion is not met: types declared in a referenced assembly are rejected. The guard `|| type.DeclaringSyntaxReferences.IsEmpty` is true for every metadata-only symbol, so `ProjectA.MyType` coming from a referenced DLL gets MsgPack021 ('data type not supported'). No formatter is generated, and the user's partial class is left without an implementation (CS0535). Only same-compilation types, the case the feature does not need, work.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.ReferencedAssemblyGeneratedFormatterTests.FormatterForTypeFromReferencedAssembly_IsGenerated and BodylessFormatterForTypeFromReferencedAssembly_IsGenerated. ProjectA is emitted to an image and referenced via MetadataReference.CreateFromImage. On head the generator reports MsgPack021, and the output compilation has CS0535 errors.

findings.claim: MessagePack or DataContract attributes on T are ignored, although the requirement says they must be honoured. When no SurrogateType is set, the collector always calls CreateContractlessMembers: every public read-write member is serialized with string keys in name order. A T carrying [MessagePackObject]/[Key]/[IgnoreMember] or [DataContract]/[DataMember] gets the wrong contract, so ignored members such as Secrets are serialized and int-key layouts become maps. The requirement allows contractless only when there is no [DataContract] or [MessagePackObject] attribute. Ledger L19 says to follow the requirement.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.AttributedTypeGeneratedFormatterTests. On head the generated MyObjectCustomFormatter source contains the [IgnoreMember] 'Secret' and the non-[DataMember] 'Unlisted' members, and uses a map header instead of WriteArrayHeader.
